input: Set up automatic bill payments online

gold.taskTitle: Set Up Automatic Bill Payments Online
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to configure automatic online payments for their bills so they are paid without manual intervention each billing cycle.

questions.title: Which specific bills do you want to automate?
questions.description: Identify the exact bills the user wants to set up autopay for, such as rent, electricity, internet, credit card, etc.

questions.title: How many bills total need to be automated?
questions.description: Determine the total number of bills so the plan can be scoped appropriately.

questions.title: Which bank or payment method will fund these payments?
questions.description: Find out whether the user plans to pay via bank account, credit card, debit card, or another payment method.

questions.title: Will autopay be set up through each biller's website or your bank?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants to use each service provider's own autopay portal or set up bill pay through their bank's platform.

questions.title: Do any of these bills vary in amount each month?
questions.description: Identify which bills are fixed versus variable, as this affects autopay strategy and risk of overdraft.

questions.title: What is your deadline for getting all this set up?
questions.description: Understand the user's timeline so tasks can be prioritized, especially around upcoming due dates.

questions.title: Have you attempted autopay before and run into issues?
questions.description: Check for prior experience or known blockers, such as failed verifications, missing account credentials, or unsupported billers.
